preconditions.description: Number of vertices is between 1 and 50.
Number of edges is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and 1 <= w <= 50 for u, v, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge has valid vertices and weight.
Starting vertex for the policeman is between 1 and n.
Number of criminals is between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and x != s for x in criminals)
preconditions.description: Each criminal is located at a valid vertex different from the starting vertex of the policeman.

postconditions.description: Output is either 'Terrorists win' or an integer representing the time needed to catch all criminals.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Terrorists win' if not can_catch_all_criminals else True
postconditions.description: If the policeman cannot catch all criminals, output 'Terrorists win'.
If the policeman can catch all criminals, the output is a non-negative integer representing the time needed.
